ground_truth.title: Wireless Ergonomic Mouse
ground_truth.main_content:
Wireless Ergonomic Mice are recommended by our in-house certified professional ergonomist to assist users seeking to alleviate pain and injuries caused by using standard computer mice. These wireless mice are versatile and have proven to reduce pain, fatigue and other issues associated with using a computer mouse.

From vertical mice like our Evoluent Mouse to the joystick-style Penguin Mouse, Human Solution offers many different wireless ergonomic mice options to help keep you comfortable and productive while you work.

Learn More About the Wireless Ergonomic Mouse

Wireless Ergonomic Mice help you combat the pain, cramping, wrist twisting and other issues associated with using a standard computer mouse for several hours. Standard mice aren't designed to offer true ergonomic comfort, but the wireless mice offered by The Human Solution are designed to keep you comfortable and healthy while you work. These wireless mice provide the same great ergonomic benefits and features of some of our most popular wired mice but without the cord.

A non-ergonomic mouse places your hand in an unnatural position causing harmful wrist pronation that can lead to pain, numbness, and even irreversible joint damage. With an ergonomic mouse, your wrist is placed in a more natural, neutral position that successfully alleviates fatigue and strain commonly associated with mousing for prolonged periods throughout the day.

We offer a variety of ergonomic mice and mouse alternatives, including vertical mice, wireless ergonomic mice, left hand ergonomic mice, hands-free mice, and mice that are Mac and PC compatible. For more information on how ergonomic mice can make you more productive and comfortable, be sure to visit our blog:
